title: S01 Seafoam Refrigerator Exterior
description: Original freestanding static double-door refrigerator exterior in the S01 seafoam and warm-ivory interior family. Overall width 0.70 m, depth 0.70 m including handles and rear detail, height 1.80 m; front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. A smaller upper freezer face and larger lower refrigerator face have modeled perimeter seals, a visible horizontal seam, fixed two-point handles, a recessed kick grille, shallow rear service-panel detail and four feet. Independently editable closed exterior components. Use as a complete standalone kitchen appliance with placement gaps; not a fitted 0.60 m cabinet module. Static exterior only: doors are solid decorative faces, with no interior cavity, hinges, opening states, animation, refrigeration, installation or load claim.
